items.difficulty_reason: 28 行、三步：①用 lift-perfect-complex-plus-locally-free 把 F ⊕（某个移位的局部自由层）提升为 X 上的 perfect 对象 E；②用 lift-map 提升一个限制后为「在局部自由项上取恒等、在 F 上取零」的分块矩阵自同态 α；③取 α 的锥即为 F⊕F[1] 的提升。承重的锥构造与两处提升的使用都在 span 内；2 处同章引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-lift-perfect-complex-plus-shift (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3614-3620

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the extension of the direct sum with a locally free summand via the plus-locally-free lemma, the construction of an endomorphism equal to the identity on the locally free summand and zero on F by the lift-map lemma, and the cone of that endomorphism as the required extension (source lines 3622-3641)
